page.overview:
Who is Adrammelech?

Adrammelech (100px), also known as Adramelk, is the fourth Lucavi demon whom Ramza Beoulve must face in Final Fantasy Tactics. He is associated with the Capricorn auracite, yet is a Scorpio as a gameplay unit, just like his vessel.

Adrammelech is one of the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice. Although it is uncertain whether he participated in his leader Ultima's initial effort to sow chaos in Ivalice during the prevailing period of the Holy Ydoran Empire, according to the legend of the Zodiac Braves, she intended to gather her companions through the auracites that Ultima supposedly created through her host, Ajora Glabados. However, she was ultimately prevented from achieving her goal due to Ajora's capture and execution due to her treacherous disciple, Germonique.

1200 years after Ultima's defeat and imprisonment within the body of her vessel, the twelve auracites that Ajora and his disciples were said to have wielded as the Zodiac Braves have been scattered throughout Ivalice, which was once again at war, this time between two duchies vying for the throne and control of the kingdom. The conflict became known as the War of the Lions, and was behind the scenes being orchestrated by Hashmal through his vessel, the Knight Templar Folmarv Tengille, to fulfill one of the main requirements of a complex ritual to resurrect Ultima. He also searched for the remaining Zodiac Stones and gave some of those he had found to potential vessels that could be possessed by his brethren so they could help him with his plans. Because the Church of Glabados had distorted the story of Ajora's life to conceal his true nature, his devotees were unaware of the Stones' ability to possess their bearers.

During Hashmal's meeting with Zalera—who was controlling Marquis Elmdore—the latter remarked Adrammelech to be stuck in a limbo and unable to assist in their goal. Hashmal revealed a suitable candidate had been found for Adrammelech's host and sent Loffrey Wodring to deliver the Capricorn Stone to Dycedarg Beoulve at Eagrose Castle.
